enrichment.summary: The Board is changing the High School Linked Learning Office's 2022-2023 plan for Measures N and H money, which supports college and career programs. It cuts facility rentals by $6,215, a program manager's extra-pay stipend by $750, and another stipend line by $535. It raises the existing $63,085 line for several independent contractors to a total of $70,585, for interim support while the Measure N/H Coordinator is on leave.

enrichment.headline: Adds $79,567 to Mar Con Builders' contract for play surfaces at Kaiser Child Development Center
enrichment.summary: This change order raises the contract with Mar Con Builders, Inc. of Oakland for the Kaiser Child Development Center Site Improvements Project. It adds soft play-mat tiles, a solar-reflecting track on the lower yard near the portables, and extra planting, covering preliminary change orders 27 and 28. The text says the contract price goes from $6,708,351 to $6,781,918.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Hires King Construction Inspection for up to $26,389 to inspect Oakland Tech's solar battery project
enrichment.summary: King Construction Inspection, Inc. of Oakland will serve as Inspector of Record, the inspector who oversees construction work, for the Solar Battery Plant Storage Project at Oakland Technical High School. The limit is $26,389, which includes up to $2,399 for additional services. Work is scheduled to run from June 13, 2024 to December 31, 2025.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Pays Global Modular $2.37M to build three modular buildings at Fremont High School
enrichment.summary: Global Modular, Inc. of Atwater will design, fabricate and install three modular buildings, creating six new spaces, as part of the Fremont High School Modernization Project. The total amount is $2,370,000. Work is expected to run from June 13, 2024 to September 1, 2025.
